categories.label: Certified supported
categories.product_wording: Certified prompt scenarios can create reviewed CGS mutations for the listed edits, then pass GDE, SGC, persistence, and runtime checks before they are treated as applied.
categories.builder_copy: This request is in the certified prompt set and can produce a reviewed mutation preview.
requirements: prompt matches a certified scenario or a tested equivalent
provider readiness is valid before PIL runs
mutation preview is created before apply
GDE applies the transaction
structural edits invoke real SGC and persist proof artifacts

examples.prompt: Set the player movement speed to 6.5.
examples.notes: Certified value mutation for an existing component field.

examples.prompt: Add a general inventory component to the player.
examples.notes: Certified structural component add with real SGC proof.

examples.prompt: Add one generic pickup object near the player.
examples.notes: Certified structural actor add using supported starter components.

categories.label: Constrained
categories.product_wording: Constrained prompt scenarios may be supported when the request maps to known CGS components, systems, assets, or values and the Builder can show exactly what will change.
categories.builder_copy: This request needs to stay within known CGS primitives and must be reviewed before apply.
requirements: target actor, component, system, asset reference, or value is identifiable
requested behavior maps to an existing or already-supported primitive
Builder can produce a bounded diff
SGC, runtime load, replay, and rollback checks remain required when relevant

examples.prompt: Add a simple stamina value to the player using the existing movement template.
examples.notes: Possible only if the generated schema maps to supported component and system primitives.

examples.prompt: Add a health pickup near the player using the existing pickup behavior.
examples.notes: Possible when the request can reuse the certified pickup primitive.

examples.prompt: Link this selected mesh reference to the pickup object.
examples.notes: Possible when the asset reference is already present and validateable.

categories.label: Clarification required
categories.product_wording: Ambiguous prompt scenarios must ask bounded clarification questions before any CGS mutation is planned or applied.
categories.builder_copy: This request is missing a target, value, scope, or supported primitive choice.
requirements: no CGS mutation is persisted before clarification is resolved
questions are bounded and tied to known Builder options
the resolved answer is recorded with the transaction

examples.notes: Needs target enemy type, changed stat, and amount.
Needs target actor and inventory behavior scope.
Needs whether this is data-only, interaction-only, or a future generated system request.

categories.label: Blocked
categories.product_wording: Blocked prompt scenarios are too broad, unsafe, or impossible to verify as a single safe CGS mutation and must not leave a pending apply transaction.
categories.builder_copy: This request is too broad for a safe CGS mutation. Start with one specific gameplay, actor, system, asset, audio, or animation edit.
requirements: no pending transaction remains
Builder returns an actionable reason
user is directed toward a smaller supported or constrained request

examples.prompt: Create any complete online game with all art, audio, animation, servers, and stores.
examples.notes: Combines unsupported scope, services, content creation, and release packaging.

examples.prompt: Package and publish my finished game for every platform.
examples.notes: Release packaging and platform publishing are outside current prompt mutation scope.

examples.prompt: Automatically convert my entire engine-native project into XACE gameplay.
examples.notes: Import is currently wrap/link plus manual mapping, not automatic conversion.

categories.label: Unsupported
categories.product_wording: Unsupported prompt scenarios request behavior XACE does not currently implement, such as engine-native scripting, external services, unsafe code, direct filesystem or network access, or unproven engine packaging.
categories.builder_copy: This request is outside the supported Builder prompt surface.
requirements: return a stable unsupported reason code when the classifier gate is enabled
do not call generated-code, SGC, runtime, engine, filesystem, or network paths for the requested unsupported behavior
offer a safe constrained alternative when one exists

examples.prompt: Write a Unity MonoBehaviour script that controls my player directly.
examples.notes: Prompt mutations must target CGS and supported generated systems, not engine-native scripts.

examples.prompt: Set up a hosted matchmaking backend and payment system.
examples.notes: Hosted services and billing are outside the current prompt surface.

examples.prompt: Read files from my desktop and use them to change the game automatically.
examples.notes: Direct filesystem access from prompts is not supported.

categories.label: Experimental
categories.product_wording: Experimental prompt scenarios are research or future-work categories. They must be labeled as experimental, hidden or gated in launch builds, and backed by separate proof before becoming supported.
categories.builder_copy: This request is experimental and is not part of the launch-supported prompt surface.
requirements: requires an explicit experiment gate
must not appear as launch-supported behavior
must produce proof artifacts before promotion to constrained or certified supported
